required_transformations: Aggregate user-level data to daily signup counts grouped by city tier
Compute conversion rate by acquisition channel using the derived converted_flag
Calculate 7-day retention rate by cohort week using the retained_7d_flag
Only provide aggregated outputs, no raw user-level detail
justification: All business questions can be answered with aggregate KPIs, making raw user-level data unnecessary
Minimum necessary data principle: only fields needed for internal query are allowed (city_tier, acquisition_channel, signup_date, converted_flag, cohort_week, retained_7d_flag)
Password hash and auth token are credential material and must never be released externally
Prefer derived flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) over raw timestamps for KPI computation
